scope: Four GitHub discovery catalogs reviewed. Four original-publisher archives downloaded and inspected. Two Kenney packs supplied selected, license-verified GLBs integrated into the live city renderer. Two Quaternius archives were audited but are held from the project library because the package CC0 declarations conflict with the current QAL standalone-redistribution restriction. No download occurs during game launch.

license_status_meaning.SOURCE_VERIFIED: Creator license statement located; archive contents, embedded licenses and third-party provenance still require checking before import.
license_status_meaning.LIVE_VERIFICATION_PENDING: Indexed primary evidence only or inaccessible page; do not download yet.
license_status_meaning.PERMISSION_SCOPE_HOLD: Custom grant found; standalone scope/provenance needs clarification.
license_status_meaning.LICENSE_CONFLICT_HOLD: Publisher/platform terms conflict; verify exact edition and package grant.
license_status_meaning.TOOL_ONLY: Code license does not license input/output art.

assets.creator: Quaternius
assets.download_route: Use publisher Download button; follow normal free-download/account flow. No archive downloaded in discovery.

assets.file_format: FBX, glTF; Blend in paid Source edition
assets.format_verification: Standard archive inspected: 18 glTF, 26 FBX and 48 PNG files. Male/female full-body GLTFs each contain 3 meshes, 1 skin and a 65-bone rig; no animation clips. Textures are mostly 2048?2048.

assets.godot_compatibility: Not imported. Free Standard model is superhero-costumed and has several 2048?2048 textures; also held because official package CC0 statements conflict with the newer general QAL restriction on redistributing raw assets.
assets.visual_fit: Low for ordinary civilians without retheming; retain as a reviewed future option.
assets.notes: Archive 128,968,391 bytes; SHA-256 fdbf1804c90dfc1ea03e992bff7da2dfd1a79318e13270a660180f9308455f40. Standard license file inside archive states CC0 1.0 and models by Quaternius. The paid Source edition is separate. Exact archive SHA-256 fdbf1804c90dfc1ea03e992bff7da2dfd1a79318e13270a660180f9308455f40. See the QAL scope hold in the report.
